<html:body
    xmlns="http://www.mozilla.org/keymaster/gatekeeper/there.is.only.xul"
  >
    <dialog
      buttonlabelaccept="&accept.label;"
      buttonaccesskeyaccept="&accept.accesskey;"
    >
      <html:label id="nameLabel" for="name" accesskey="&rename.accesskey;"
        >&rename.label;</html:label
      >
      <html:input
        id="name"
        type="text"
        class="input-inline"
        aria-labelledby="nameLabel"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The rename-folder dialog removes the inline label display style but retains its label/input relationship. Accepted source has nameLabel, for=name, aria-labelledby=nameLabel and initial focus/select; acceptance remains disabled for an empty value. Treat this as local presentation cleanup, not proof of every long-label or translated layout. The separate 1853 line wrap is a formatter follow-up and adds no new manual rule. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.
title: Preserve native label relationships when removing inline presentation
